2026-10-20SB&TCanadian Tourism Commission ActAppointment of the President of the Canadian Tourism CommissionApproval of the designation by the Board of Directors of the Canadian Tourism Commission of Meaghan Ferrigno of Burnaby, British Columbia, to be interim President of the Canadian Tourism Commission, to hold office during pleasure for a term of one year, or until such time as a new President is appointed, whichever occurs first.N/A
subject: Appointment of the President of the Canadian Tourism Commission
precis: Approval of the designation by the Board of Directors of the Canadian Tourism Commission of Meaghan Ferrigno of Burnaby, British Columbia, to be interim President of the Canadian Tourism Commission, to hold office during pleasure for a term of one year, or until such time as a new President is appointed, whichever occurs first.
